The original AP credit (2000) is 9124.30, and the debit to expense (5500) is 9151.30. The likely error is that the expense debit is overstated, so the AP side is the correct amount and the correction should adjust the expense side instead.

A correction that reduces the 5500 debit by 27.00 (a one-sided CR to 5500) brings the group to balance: original DR 9151.30 plus correction DR 0 = 9151.30 vs original CR 9124.30 plus correction CR 27.00 = 9151.30. This keeps the 2000 AP control credit at 9124.30, consistent with the AP invoice amount, and avoids introducing an AP/GL mismatch.
